title: Ricochet Royale
description: Three shots. Every wall is a weapon. Dodge your own ricochets in a neon tank arena for up to eight players.
author: Isaac
controls: WASD or arrow keys to move. Mouse to aim; hold click or Space to fire. Mobile: left stick to move, right stick to aim and fire. Three shots, then a two-second reload. Your own bounced bullets are lethal.
